name: Guardian
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: Moderate Perception; high Athletics; high Str; high to extreme AC; high Fortitude, low Reflex; high HP; resistance to physical damage based on level; moderate accuracy; moderate damage. Abilities: Shield Block, Intercept Attack, one extra reaction each round to use for any reaction specified in statblock (two extra reactions at level 7 or higher), Taunt

notes.defense: High to extreme AC; high Fortitude, low Reflex; high HP; resistance to physical damage based on its level.
notes.offense: Moderate attack bonus and moderate damage.
notes.specials: Shield Block, Intercept Attack, Taunt; one extra reaction each round to use for any reaction in its stat block (two extra reactions at level 7 or higher).
